ready.title: Readiness
ready.description: What calls and builds need, and how to fix what's missing.
ready.restart: Saved settings wait for a restart.
ready.mcpRestart: The MCP server still serves the settings it started with.
ready.keys.missing: Missing: {names}. Calls can't start without them.
ready.keys.ok: Saved for Soniox, OpenRouter and Fish Audio.
ready.voice.none: She has no voice yet, so calls can't start.
ready.voice.bad: Fish Audio can't use her voice ({id}): it is private or gone.
ready.voice.badEnv: The voice she inherits from FISH_VOICE_ID ({id}) isn't usable on Fish Audio. Pick her own.
ready.voice.unchecked: Her voice ({id}) hasn't been checked with Fish Audio yet.
ready.voice.uncheckedEnv: She inherits FISH_VOICE_ID ({id}), which hasn't been checked with Fish Audio yet.
ready.voice.ok: Her own voice works with Fish Audio.
ready.voice.env: Inherited from FISH_VOICE_ID in the environment, and works with Fish Audio.
ready.memory.off: Off: she won't remember you between calls.
ready.memory.down: Qdrant isn't answering, so memory is off for now.
ready.memory.unchecked: Set up, but Qdrant hasn't been checked yet.
ready.memory.on: On: she remembers you from one call to the next.
ready.facts.none: No index yet: she knows only her prompt.
ready.facts.stale: Built with other embedding settings: build it again.
ready.streams.none: Not built yet: she can't recall past broadcasts.
ready.streams.stale: Built with other embedding settings: build it again.
ready.streams.noCatalog: Built, but the broadcast overview isn't.
ready.selfies.none: No outfit references, so she can't take selfies.
ready.ytdlp.onFirstDownload: Installs itself on the first download.
ready.ytdlp.unavailable: Unavailable, so videos can't be downloaded. Install it with brew install yt-dlp or pip install yt-dlp: Eidolon then uses the one on your PATH.
ready.ffmpeg.missing: Not installed. Only videos over 5 hours need it: brew install ffmpeg, apt install ffmpeg or winget install ffmpeg.
ready.disk.low: Only {free} free on the data home's disk. Downloaded audio takes a lot of space.
ready.disk.ok: {free} free on the data home's disk.
personas.title: Your personas
personas.description: Open one's studio to build her up, or make another the one your calls reach.
personas.inCall: A call is in progress: switch personas after it ends.
personas.newBody: Her own name, prompt and voice.
memory.title: What {name} remembers about you
memory.description: She picks these up in your calls, and only she reads them: each persona remembers on her own.
memory.label: What {name} remembers
memory.empty: {name} starts remembering you from your next call.
memory.off: Memory is off, so she forgets you after every call. It needs Qdrant, a database you run in Docker on this machine. Run this once in a terminal, then turn memory on:
memory.down: Qdrant isn't answering, so she can't remember or recall anything for now. Start Docker, or start Qdrant if it isn't running:
memory.downNote: Calls go on without memory meanwhile.
memory.forgetBody: This deletes all {count} memories {name} keeps of you, for good. Other personas keep theirs.
